messages:
June: quick thread — CatalystAI case study timing. goal: publish next Thu 9am PT, include webinar CTA and a short bench note. Need interview transcript, approved quote, 2 socials, HubSpot routing. who can own ops?

Arman: I can run ops. booked interview with CatalystAI Head of Infra Fri 9am PT. audio + transcript, 20m. added recorder to checklist.

Leah: I'll draft hero + 3 social variants. what's the final numbers?

Tom: Metrics confirmed: p95 latency down from 310ms -> 100ms (~3.1x) and steady-state serving cost down 30%. doc: <https://docs.redwood/internal/catalystai-metrics>.

June: great. Leah, lead copy. Arman, add recorder link to content checklist and attach transcript after the call. use the case-interview template.

Arman: done: <https://drive.redwood/internal/checklists/catalystai-2580>. recorder link in doc. CMS draft created: <https://cms.redwood/drafts/catalystai-2580>.

Leah: draft hero: "CatalystAI reduced p95 latency about 3x and lowered serving costs by 30% with Redwood." social short: "See how CatalystAI cut p95 latency ~3x — read the case + join our May webinar."

June: legal heads-up — Courtney, please run the quote through LegalBot. need signoff by Wed EOD to hit Thu publish.

LegalBot: received. Submit quote via <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=catalystai-2580>. ETA 24-48h.

Leah: proposed quote from transcript: "Redwood helped us shrink tail latency and reduce serving costs so we could ship faster." will refine to numbers once legal ok.

Tom: recommend numeric quote: "Redwood reduced our p95 latency by about 3x and reduced serving costs by 30%, which let us accelerate releases."

Leah: updated quote and submitted to LegalBot.

LegalBot: initial review: please replace "our" with company name and avoid "shrink" in public copy. Also confirm customer name usage and upload consent.

Arman: consent uploaded to approval form.

LegalBot: approved with minor edits; final approval attached: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/catalystai-2580/approved.pdf>.

June: good. Leah, update CMS with approved quote and final assets (2 socials + hero image). Tom, set HubSpot mapping and UTM.

Tom: HubSpot flow created: catalystai_case_flow. UTMs set: utm_campaign=catalystai_case&utm_medium=post. AE webhook -> #ae-notify. smoke test passed.

Leah: assets uploaded to drive and CMS updated. social captions tweaked per legal. Buffer scheduled for Thu 9am PT pending final QA.

Arman: I'll run final QA on the CMS draft and confirm Buffer schedule tomorrow morning.

SalesOps: webhook verified. sample lead delivered with UTM params. AE queue mapping good.

June: perfect. final checklist: 1) CMS draft 2) legal approval 3) HubSpot flow live 4) buffer queued 5) assets uploaded. All confirmed. I'll post announce in #general after publish. Locking thread. :rocket:
